Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain Announced for Switch 2 - News

 2
by William D'Angelo , posted 21 hours ago / 656 Views
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:55
Instaread

Level-5 has announced a remake of Yo-kai Watch 2, titled Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain, for the Nitnendo Switch 2.

"We’re keeping everything that made Yo-kai Watch 2 so special while completely revamping the graphics!," said Level-5. "We’re also hard at work developing new features, including additional story content and new Yo-kai!"
